jq.q1:
```
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and ((((.title // "") + " " + (.body // "")) | ascii_downcase | contains("security"))))] | length' issues.json
```
jq.q5:
```
jq -r '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and (.is_pr | not) and .comments > 5) | .number] | sort | map(tostring) | join(",")' issues.json
```
jq.q7:
```
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and any(.labels[]; . == "bug"))] | length' issues.json
```
jq.q9:
```
jq '([.[] | select(.is_pr | not) | .user] | unique) as $i | [.[] | select(.is_pr) | .user] | unique | map(select(IN($i[]))) | length' issues.json
```
jq.q10:
```
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and (.is_pr | not)) | .comments] | (add / length * 100 | round) / 100' issues.json
```

aethershell.q1:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json | where(fn(r) => r.state == "open" && ((r.title + " " + r.body) | lower | contains("security"))) | len
```
aethershell.q3:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json | where(fn(r) => r.state == "closed") | map(fn(r) => r.comments) | sum
```
aethershell.q4:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json | where(fn(r) => r.is_pr) | group("user") | sort_by("Count") | last | fn(g) => g.Name + " " + (g.Count | str)
```
aethershell.q5:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json | where(fn(r) => r.state == "open" && !r.is_pr && r.comments > 5) | map(fn(r) => r.number) | sort
```
aethershell.q6:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json | map(fn(r) => r.labels) | flatten | unique | len
```
aethershell.q7:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json | where(fn(r) => r.state == "open" && (r.labels | any(fn(l) => l == "bug"))) | len
```
aethershell.q9:
```
let rows = cat("issues.json") | from_json
let issuers = rows | where(fn(r) => !r.is_pr) | map(fn(r) => r.user) | unique
rows | where(fn(r) => r.is_pr) | map(fn(r) => r.user) | unique | where(fn(u) => issuers | any(fn(i) => i == u)) | len
```
aethershell.q10:
```
cat("issues.json") | from_json | where(fn(r) => r.state == "open" && !r.is_pr) | map(fn(r) => r.comments) | avg | round(2)
```
